STATUS: plant is under construction (S26); GM said on 2026-05-20/22 that construction 'will be paused' to align capacity with demand and to 'finish the building's exterior' (S29); Samsung's Aug 2026 release still calls it under construction, and its Q3 2026 call says mass production 'between the second half of 2028 and early 2029' (S27, previous plan 2027 S28). project_state=paused chosen because no source says work restarted; alternative 'active' (Samsung describes it as under construction) rejected - flag for lead. Confidence 0.55 because a 36 GWh plant has a paused/uncertain schedule and a 2024 capacity figure: see ESCALATE in hand-off. Not re-verified: announced_year, coordinates.
